name: WW Biosec — LIMS Ingest Scheduler
description: Scheduled workflow: polls a LIMS HTTP endpoint (or S3/SFTP drop) for new wastewater sample results, transforms them into ww_api round payloads, and POSTs them. Disabled by default — activate once LIMS_BASE_URL is configured.
_notes: Set LIMS_BASE_URL to your LIMS API base URL (e.g. https://lims.bphs.bz).
Set WW_API_BASE_URL to your ww_api address (e.g. http://ww_api:8080).
Configure two httpBearerAuth credentials: one for LIMS, one for ww_api (WW_API_TOKEN).
If LIMS delivers CSV files to an SFTP drop, replace 'Fetch LIMS results' with an SFTP Read node and add a CSV parse step before 'Group by analyte'.
409 responses from POST /v1/rounds mean a round for that analyte/date already exists — safe to ignore.

The ww_api round order constraint means this cron must run once per calendar day and not backfill without changing the ingestion order. For late arrivals, implement a replay endpoint (PUT /v1/rounds) or ingest them in a separate catch-up workflow.
